Zamane Bhar Mein Hai Charcha Imam Mehdi Ka.
Hai Kainat Ka Pora Nizam Mehdi Ka.

1
Imam-e-Waqt Ki Onchi Hai Manzlat Sab Se.
Buland Martaba Aala Moqam Mehdi Ka.
Najoom Shams-o-Qamar Aasman Our Zameen.
Pukartay Hain Yeh Har Waqt Naam Mehdi Ka.

2
Tumhein Bachaye Ga Iss Door-e-Purfitan Mein Wohi.
Nijat Ke Liye Daman Lo Tham Mehdi Ka.
Khuda Ki Sari Ataein Inhi Ke Dam Se Hain.
Dua Ko Rab Se Milana Hai Kam Mehdi Ka.

3
Marey Imam Ki Ghaibat Pe Bhonkne Walo.
Tumhein Tu Kafi Hai Bas Ik Ghulam Mehdi Ka.
Jo Main Ne Madh-e-Imam-e-Zamaan Likhi Hasnain.
Haqeeqatan Hai Yeh Mujh Par Inam Mehdi Ka.

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/zamane-bhar-mein-hai-charcha-imam-mehdi-ka-tajpoints-8fe18671f41de61d0976.md')
_, header, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = header.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
assert all(not line or line.startswith('  ') for line in roman.splitlines())
for edition, numbers in ((roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')):
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [len(block) for block in blocks] == [2, 5, 5, 5]
    assert [block[0].strip() for block in blocks[1:]] == list(numbers)
assert 'noUrdu' not in header and 'direction: \"rtl\"' in header
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified 14 verses in each edition, with matching preamble and stanza structure.')
PY"
